objective: Complete the remaining method ablations for Production Shared count codec on the fixed 50 exposed HEST development slices without changing K=32, M_s=6, historical evidence, protected data, or the canonical recovery contract.

inputs.source_role: same exposed 50-slice development/calibration panel; no protected confirmation data

primary_hypotheses: H_order: Production Shared rate is not materially dependent on arbitrary storage row order after paying the mapping required for original-order recovery.
H_context: support and value spatial contexts contribute separable physical-byte savings and may interact.
H_bucket: a fixed support Q12 bucket count other than 8 can reduce pooled physical archive bytes under a nested pre-registered boundary rule.
null_hypotheses: Arbitrary row order changes only the representation and mapping cost, with no practically relevant codec advantage for canonical spatial traversal.
Turning either context off does not reduce total physical archive bytes once all model and graph costs are paid.
B_s=8 is not improved by the tested nested alternatives.

primary_endpoints.order: full physical archive bytes including mapping; exact original-order recovery after independent decode
primary_endpoints.context_2x2: pooled full physical archive bytes, with support/value streams, model members, graph and metadata separately reconciled
primary_endpoints.support_buckets: pooled full physical archive bytes; B=8 must reproduce the Production anchor byte-for-byte

frozen_bucket_rule.name: nested-q12-v1
frozen_bucket_rule.lower_counts: select every (8/B)th B=8 edge, retaining 1 and 4096
frozen_bucket_rule.b16_edges: insert floor((a+b)/2) between each adjacent B=8 edge, retaining the original edges
frozen_bucket_rule.selection: minimum pooled full bytes; <=0.05 percent tied, choose smaller B

allowed_changes: new isolated evidence directory and codec wrappers
new output archives and ledgers under the new task only
reuse hash-verified historical S0V1/S1V1 archives for semantic audit and B=8 anchor
forbidden_changes: modify or replace historical evidence, archives, source data, protected confirmation data, K=32, M_s=6, Production metadata schema, or rANS precision
select samples, boundaries, seeds, or endpoints after viewing final sizes
drop failures, replace samples, or report NLL without full physical bytes
claim universal optimality, causal biological generalization, or arbitrary-order invariance beyond this panel
acceptance_criteria: framing and reviewer challenge are recorded before implementation
source, manifest, anchor, runtime and new-code SHA256 pins are recorded
preflight passes synthetic edge cases and at least one real slice per new arm
all planned successful archives are independently decoded in fresh processes and exact recovery is verified
all failures, interruptions and retries are retained
each archive has a physical ledger summing exactly to file size
independent read-only audit and separate reproduction pass
method coverage audit marks 50-sample, 3-sample, design-constant, invariant and unverified items
